project_type: Next.js 16 App Router with TypeScript, feature-based architecture
build_system: npm with Next.js 16.2.10, Turbopack for dev
test_framework: Vitest with @testing-library/react, fast-check for property tests. Tests in src/features/{name}/__tests__/ and src/shared/__tests__/
build_command: eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npm run build
test_command: eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npm run test
verification_instructions: 1. npx tsc --noEmit 2. npm run lint 3. npm run test 4. npm run build
setup_instructions: eval "$(mise activate bash)" to activate Node.js via mise
environment_constraints: Open internet. No real DB (uses localStorage). No Supabase env vars (auth degrades gracefully). No OpenAI/Anthropic keys available.
contribution_requirements: Feature-based folders (src/features/{name}/). No cross-feature imports (shared in src/shared/). No TODOs/placeholders. Never use useSyncExternalStore for one-time localStorage reads. Never call router.push during render. Theme: Navy #002B5C, Gold #C5A258, Green #00843D, Background #0a0e14.
key_patterns: localStorage for all user data. PracticeAttempt type stores per-question results with moduleResults array. Question type has id, difficulty (Easy/Medium/Hard), subject, topic. Formulas have FormulaEntry with examFrequency and difficulty. CFA_SUBJECTS_ORDERED (10 subjects) and CFA_CURRICULUM_WEIGHTS in shared/config/subjects.ts. AI provider configured via env vars (openai/anthropic). Existing weak-topic-engine.ts, difficulty-progression.ts, readiness-calculator.ts for analytics.
directory_structure: src/app/(protected)/ - route pages. src/features/{name}/ - feature modules with components/, utils/, types/, __tests__/. src/shared/ - shared utilities, hooks, config, components/layout. src/features/question-bank/data/ - question data files (1283 questions across subjects).
